Access /data, /system and other system directories via Shizuku without root
Detected %1$s is installed. You can use it to get ADB permission to access /data and other system directories. Select an app to authorize:

ADB (Android Debug Bridge) permission allows apps to execute operations with debug privileges.

Usage:
1. Install Shizuku app
2. Start Shizuku service via Wireless Debugging (Android 11+) or USB connection
3. Authorize this File Manager in Shizuku
4. After authorization, you can browse /data, /system and other system directories

Difference from Root:
• ADB permission level is lower than Root, but sufficient for most system directories
• No device root required, safer
• Can be revoked anytime via Shizuku
